title: UGP Lite+ (Ultimate Greenscreen Pack)
description: Ultimate chroma key / green screen (greenscreen) pack. Now vanilla freindly using double slabs of commonly gotten stone and vanilla emissiveness.
body:
The ultimate greenscreen pack is now back in another flavor this time focusing on vanilla freindlyness by using doubleslabs to make the chromakey/greenscreen blocks i hope this will help ppl get those screenshots/videos they want in minecraft :D

The [Normal Lite](https://modrinth.com/project/zU3QjLgX) is out!
